d: A new political alliance between Asaduddin Owaisi’s AIMIM and Chandrashekhar Azad’s Azad Samaj Party (Kanshi Ram) has stirred up Uttar Pradesh’s political landscape ahead of the 2027 Assembly elections. Named the Samajik Parivartan Morcha, the alliance has projected Chandrashekhar Azad as its Chief Ministerial face, aiming to consolidate the Muslim-Dalit vote, which accounts for nearly 40% of Uttar Pradesh’s population.
